protocol.purpose: Exploratory same-state comparison on our signed future-xG task, not a product superiority test
protocol.model_policy: Reuse frozen three-seed GNN, ball and no-message ensembles; no retraining or test-based tuning
protocol.xg_source: Existing StatsBomb goal-trained geometry model; not provider StatsBomb xG
protocol.target: signed first shot xG in (t,t+15s], same period, full horizon required, including interruptions
protocol.sampling: Exact player-possession start frame; start matched; tracking possession team agrees with event team; provider for and against values present; unique event per period/frame
protocol.provider_net: for minus against; possession_epv_total is not a state value
protocol.adaptation: Unregularized affine least squares fitted only on the existing three validation matches; provider uses both for and against components; net-only affine and GNN affine also reported
protocol.metric: pooled snapshot MSE/RMSE with paired whole-match descriptive bootstrap
protocol.evaluation_status: Existing three test matches were previously evaluated; this is an exploratory extension, not a new untouched test
protocol.provider_limitations: Unknown provider training overlap and exact open-data model version; current product describes a different horizon and goal target

limitations: Transferred geometric xG is an estimated target, not verified goals or official StatsBomb xG.
Provider horizon, interruption handling and goal target differ; raw MSE is not a like-for-like native evaluation.
Only three test matches, already used in earlier evaluation; exploratory extension.
SkillCorner training-data overlap and open-data model version are unknown.
Event-start selection and detection filtering restrict the evaluated population.
Bootstrap conditions on fitted models; no xG-transfer, refit or label uncertainty.
